files.biosensor_kinetics.sbml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<sbml xmlns="http://www.sbml.org/sbml/level2/version4" level="2" version="4">
  <model id="BiosensorKinetics" name="Arsenite Biosensor Dynamic Model">
    <listOfCompartments>
      <compartment id="cell" size="1.0" constant="true"/>
    </listOfCompartments>
    <listOfSpecies>
      <species id="ArsR" compartment="cell" initialConcentration="3.0" constant="false"/>
      <species id="GFP_out" compartment="cell" initialConcentration="0.1" constant="false"/>
    </listOfSpecies>
    <listOfParameters>
      <parameter id="k_max" value="16.0" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="K_rep" value="1.5" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="kd" value="0.5" constant="true"/>
    </listOfParameters>
    <listOfReactions>
      <reaction id="R_gfp_syn" reversible="false">
        <listOfProducts><speciesReference species="GFP_out" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfProducts>
        <listOfModifiers><modifierSpeciesReference species="ArsR"/></listOfModifiers>
        <kineticLaw><formula>k_max / (1 + pow(ArsR / K_rep, 2))</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
      <reaction id="R_gfp_deg" reversible="false">
        <listOfReactants><speciesReference species="GFP_out" stoichiometry="1"/></listOfReactants>
        <kineticLaw><formula>kd * GFP_out</formula></kineticLaw>
      </reaction>
    </listOfReactions>
  </model>
</sbml>
